businesses.business: branded hot dogs and restaurant franchising

offering_description.value: Sells branded hot dogs and related meat products through licensed retail grocery and foodservice channels, and franchises quick-service restaurants under its name. Also operates company-owned restaurants, selling food directly to consumers.

primary_products.value: hot dogs; sausages; prepared meat products; condiments

customer_segment.value: B2C: consumers buying at company-owned restaurants and in grocery stores; B2B: franchisees, licensees, foodservice operators and food distributors

end_markets.value: quick-service restaurants; retail grocery; foodservice; consumer snacks

revenue_model.value: licensing or royalties: royalties on branded products sold by licensees in retail and foodservice; service fees: franchise fees and royalties paid by franchised restaurant operators; product sales: food and beverages sold at company-operated restaurants
revenue_model.category: licensing or royalties; service fees; product sales

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: owns the brand and licenses it for products made by others, sold to retailers and foodservice; retailer: company-operated restaurants sell prepared food directly to consumers

geography_served.value: US national: nationwide US retail and franchised restaurants, plus a few international franchise locations

specialization.value: related lines: branded hot dog products, restaurant franchising and company-operated restaurants

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: foodservice distributors supplying restaurants and food operators; third-party retail: grocery stores and warehouse clubs selling branded packaged products; own locations: company-operated restaurant at its Coney Island site; partners / resellers: licensees and franchisees operating under the brand
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; third-party retail; own locations; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: food safety and meat labeling rules from FDA and USDA, franchise disclosure rules from the FTC

notes: The extent of international franchise locations is uncertain.
